thread:
raj: Heads-up — marketing announced two overlapping promos next week (EMEA mornings + NA late nights). Projection shows ~3x baseline qps in those windows. Can infra leads triage capacity + quick mitigations?

maya: ack. I can run a short sim to validate GPU-hours and tail latency. do we have updated traffic shape?

raj: updated synthetic from growth team attached (very spiky, 20–30% microbursts). moving window: 3 days of rolling bursts.

anna: short checklist: 1) prewarm KV caches 2) bump in-region warm pools 3) tighten autoscale cooldowns 4) enable cheaper fallback model variants for non-critical routes.

mike: agree on fallback models. cost calc: switching 40% of low-priority traffic to quantized gpt-lite saves ~58% GPU-hours in sim.

maya: running sim now: `infra simulate --profile promo_overlap --duration 72h --qps-burst 4x --spike-pattern microburst`

sre-bot: Simulation started: promo_overlap. ETA 90s. Results will be posted to #eng-infra-results. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mike: network constraint note — AMS region has known NIC egress cap on certain instance types; we should avoid oversubscribing that AZ for heavy streaming.

anna: plan: spread prewarm across AMS and FRA, set routing policy to prefer FR for long-lived sessions, AMS for bursty short requests. add circuit-breaker at 95th percentile latency.

raj: what about reserved capacity? can we temporarily bump Dedicated pools? cost OK for 48h if it avoids SLO violations. ops budget sign-off?

ops-rotation: ops approves temporary commit for up to 72h if we have automated decommit after window. need exact GPU-hour delta.

maya: sim finished. headline: baseline 1.0 -> peak 3.2x. Without mitigations 48h extra = +2,900 GPU-hours. With fallbacks + cache warm + routing = +420 GPU-hours. attaching summary link (internal).

mike: that's a huge delta. recommend: 1) enable fallback routes (40% low-priority) 2) prewarm 25% of expected peak distributed 3) add token-based rate limiter for trial-tier 4) enable auto-decommit at T+72h.

raj: can we automate the rollout? I don't want manual toggles at midnight.

anna: yes — template: `infra apply promo-overlap --prewarm 25% --fallback 40% --decommit 72h --route-policy geo-spread` tests in staging pass.

maya: I'll run a dry-run deploy tomorrow 06:00 UTC and schedule the auto-decommit.

ops-rotation: make sure billing tags are set per-customer; we need postmortem cost breakdown.

mike: add a temporary metric: `promo_peak_fallback_hit_rate` so we can measure how much traffic moved to cheaper variants.

raj: love it. assign owners: maya = sim + deploy, anna = routing + breakers, mike = cost tracking, ops-rotation = budget gating. Follow-up sync 5h before window to confirm numbers. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: Reminder scheduled: Promo overlap prelaunch check in 5 hours.

maya: thanks all. I'll post the dry-run logs in this thread after the deploy.
